name: direct-sa-to-stock-sst-relative-diagnostic
objective: Measure the effect of changing only the turbulence closure from the reconstructed documented OpenFOAM Spalart-Allmaras control to packaged OpenFOAM v2512 kOmegaSST on the identical NASA 897x257 mesh and incompressible solver path.
fixed_invariants: NASA TMR altered closed NACA 0012 897x257 mesh and all polyMesh files
alpha=0 deg, U=51.4815 m/s, nu=8.58e-6 m2/s, chord Reynolds number 6000174.825
incompressible simpleFoam in the same digest-pinned OpenFOAM v2512 image
pressure, velocity, force coefficient, reference area, and quarter-chord moment conventions
SIMPLE pressure and velocity relaxation inherited byte-for-byte from the settled SA source

declared_changes.turbulence_model: SpalartAllmaras to packaged kOmegaSST with default coefficients
declared_changes.required_fields: Remove nuTilda; initialize k and omega from NASA TMR freestream ratios and nut consistently; use fixed-zero wall k/nut and the TMR factor-10 fixed wall omega values.
declared_changes.required_numerical_entries: Replace only nuTilda convection, linear-solver, and relaxation entries by corresponding k and omega entries with identical schemes and relaxation values.
declared_changes.initialization: Copy converged U and p from the source SA case; do not transfer SA nut into the SST closure.

predeclared_outputs.primary_effect: mean Cd(stock SST) minus mean Cd(source SA) over the final 100 iterations
predeclared_outputs.settling: final-100 peak-to-peak <= max(0.001, 1% of absolute coefficient mean)
predeclared_outputs.trend: projected absolute change over 500 iterations within Cd 0.0002, Cl 0.004, and CmPitch 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.residuals: final-100 maximum initial residual <= 1e-5 for p, Ux, Uy, k, and omega
predeclared_outputs.zero_angle_symmetry: absolute mean Cl <= 0.004 and absolute mean quarter-chord CmPitch <= 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.force_agreement: absolute mean Cd minus NASA CFL3D SST Cd <= 0.0002

decision_rule: Retain and report the result regardless of outcome. It may quantify a relative model effect but cannot pass strict Gate 2 or support rocket design while Gate 1 is failed. Do not tune coefficients, conditions, schemes, relaxation, or tolerances after observing the result.
